farm.the_dream_table.sugarcane.info.how:
Sugar cane grows on mud next to water.
When a cane gets tall, an observer sees it and a piston breaks the grown part.
Hoppers under the row carry the cane into the chest.
farm.the_dream_table.sugarcane.info.work:
The farm is loaded (you are near, or Keep Loaded is on).
The water, mud, pistons and observers are all in place.
The chest has room.
farm.the_dream_table.sugarcane.info.tips:
Cane grows slowly: Keep Loaded and come back later.
Empty the chest from time to time; when it is full the farm stops collecting.
farm.the_dream_table.bamboo.info.how:
Bamboo grows on mud.
When it gets tall, an observer sees it and a piston breaks the grown part.
Hoppers under the row carry the bamboo into the chest.
farm.the_dream_table.bamboo.info.works:
The farm is loaded (you are near, or Keep Loaded is on).
The chest has room.
farm.the_dream_table.bamboo.info.tips:
Bamboo is a fuel and makes sticks and scaffolding.
Empty the chest from time to time.
farm.the_dream_table.cactus.info.how:
Cactus grows on sand.
The items it drops go through a hopper into the chest.
farm.the_dream_table.cactus.info.works:
The farm is loaded (you are near, or Keep Loaded is on).
The chest has room.
farm.the_dream_table.cactus.info.output: Cactus. Smelt it for green dye.
farm.the_dream_table.cactus.info.tips: Empty the chest from time to time; when it is full the farm stops collecting.
farm.the_dream_table.crop.info.how:
Watered farmland ready for planting.
The table builds the farmland, the water and the hopper that feeds the chest. You plant the crops.
farm.the_dream_table.crop.info.works:
You planted seeds, carrots, potatoes or beetroot on the farmland.
The farm is loaded (you are near, or Keep Loaded is on).
The chest has room.
farm.the_dream_table.crop.info.tips: Bring the seeds before you leave: the table does not plant them.
farm.the_dream_table.honey.info.how:
Bees fill the nests with honey while poppies are close.
Dispensers take the honey out of full nests, and hoppers carry it to the chest.
farm.the_dream_table.honey.info.works:
You put bees in the bee nests: the table does not place them.
You loaded the dispensers with glass bottles.
The farm is loaded (you are near, or Keep Loaded is on).
The chest has room.
farm.the_dream_table.honey.info.tips:
Break a bee nest with a Silk Touch pickaxe to keep the bees inside it, then place it here.
Bees can be led with a flower, so you can capture them.
Hostile mobs spawn in the dark on the top platform.
Water carries them down the tall tower.
The fall hurts them and the campfires at the bottom finish them off.
Hoppers collect the drops into the chest.

A player is within 128 blocks of the farm. The game spawns nothing farther away, even if it is loaded.
The tower is dark: keep it free of light you added.
Whatever the mobs drop: bones, string, gunpowder, arrows, rotten flesh.

Build it over the ocean so it does not compete for spawns with mobs on land.
On land it still works, but it is less efficient because it competes for spawns with the other mobs around it.
Empty the chest from time to time.
farm.the_dream_table.iron_golem.info.how:
Villagers living in beds make iron golems appear.
Water carries the golems to lava, and hoppers bring their drops to the chests.
farm.the_dream_table.iron_golem.info.wor:
You brought the villagers, and each one has a bed: the table does not place them.
The farm is loaded (you are near, or Keep Loaded is on).
The chests have room.
farm.the_dream_table.iron_golem.info.tip:
Bring the villagers and any scare mob the design needs with a boat or a minecart.
Empty the chests from time to time.
farm.the_dream_table.gold.info.how:
Zombified piglins spawn on the magma blocks in the Nether.
The turtle eggs lure them to the edge of the platform, and they fall down the tower.
Hoppers at the bottom collect their drops into the chests.
farm.the_dream_table.gold.info.works:
It can only be built in the Nether, not in the Overworld or the End. For maximum efficiency, build it above the Nether bedrock layer, in the Nether Wastes biome: zombified piglins will not spawn on it in other biomes.
A player is within 128 blocks of the farm. The game spawns nothing farther away, even if it is loaded.
The chests have room.
farm.the_dream_table.gold.info.output: Gold nuggets and rotten flesh, and rarely gold ingots and golden swords. Kill them yourself to get their XP.
farm.the_dream_table.gold.info.tips:
Hit the piglins that land at the bottom with a projectile, or keep a zombified piglin in a boat beside you in the safe spot.
Hit that piglin and all the others rush to the trap: kill them there and the items fall through the hoppers into the chest.
Build it away from nether fortresses and bastions, where other mobs spawn.
Empty the chests from time to time.
farm.the_dream_table.creeper.info.how:
Only creepers spawn, in the dark on the top platform.
Water carries them down the tall tower.
The fall hurts them and the campfires at the bottom finish them off.
Hoppers collect the gunpowder into the chest.
farm.the_dream_table.creeper.info.works:
A player is within 128 blocks of the farm. The game spawns nothing farther away, even if it is loaded.
The platform is dark: do not add light to it.
The chest has room.
farm.the_dream_table.creeper.info.tips:
Build it over the ocean so it does not compete for spawns with mobs on land.
On land it still works, but it is less efficient because it competes for spawns with the other mobs around it.
Empty the chest from time to time.
